tool_input.description: Load prediction log CSV into BigQuery table

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty \
"SELECT COUNT(*) n, MIN(ts) mn, MAX(ts) mx, AVG(prediction) avg, MIN(prediction) mnp, MAX(prediction) mxp FROM \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}_prediction_log\`" 2>&1 | tail -20

TBL="${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}_prediction_log"
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty \
"SELECT COUNT(*) n, MIN(ts) mn, MAX(ts) mx, AVG(prediction) avg FROM ${TBL}" 2>&1 | tail -20

TBL="${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}_prediction_log"
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv \
"SELECT DATE(ts) d, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(prediction),4) mean, ROUND(STDDEV(prediction),4) sd FROM ${TBL} GROUP BY d ORDER BY d" 2>&1 | tail -95

TBL="${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}_prediction_log"
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty \
"WITH d AS (SELECT DATE(ts) day, AVG(prediction) m FROM ${TBL} GROUP BY day),
 g AS (SELECT day, m, AVG(m) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) prev3,
        AVG(m) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) next3 FROM d)
 SELECT day, ROUND(m,3) mean, ROUND(next3-prev3,3) jump FROM g
 ORDER BY ABS(next3-prev3) DESC LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | tail -12
tool_input.description: Change-point detection via rolling mean jump

tool_input.command:
TBL="${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}_prediction_log"
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty \
"SELECT DATE(ts) day, MIN(prediction) mn, MAX(prediction) mx, COUNTIF(prediction>4) hi, COUNT(*) n
 FROM ${TBL} WHERE DATE(ts) BETWEEN '2026-02-25' AND '2026-02-26' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day" 2>&1 | tail -8
